import adsk.core, adsk.fusion, json, os
def run(_context):
    app=adsk.core.Application.get(); out=[]; base='/Users/daiki/Projects/sage60/mechanical/gasket_v1/'
    for i in range(app.documents.count):
        doc=app.documents.item(i); des=adsk.fusion.Design.cast(doc.products.itemByProductType('DesignProductType'))
        if not des: continue
        root=des.rootComponent
        if not root.bRepBodies.count: continue
        first=root.bRepBodies.item(0).name
        if first=='LEFT_CONTOUR_CASE_BOTTOM': stem='sage60_left_case_contour'
        elif first=='RIGHT_CONTOUR_CASE_BOTTOM': stem='sage60_right_tb_case_contour'
        else: continue
        doc.activate(); mgr=des.exportManager
        a=bool(mgr.execute(mgr.createSTEPExportOptions(base+stem+'_bottom.step',root)))
        b=bool(mgr.execute(mgr.createSTEPExportOptions(base+stem+'_complete.step',root)))
        out.append({'stem':stem,'bottomStep':a,'completeStep':b})
    print(json.dumps(out))
